verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion is a fair privacy axis for an identity-verification service, but the evidence pack contains no documented retention settings, redaction, or deletion capability. The cited docs only cover accessing collected images and extracted data later (docs-4, docs-7, docs-16), which is the opposite of deletion control, and the community worry about data security (comm-8) does not show any capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
